finding: Derived topology must preserve copy/parent/sibling/ancestor lineage without collapsing equal artifact digests into one SELF. A lineage graph materially outperformed an all-pairs peer matrix in the local copy benchmark and avoids using peer density as truth or identity.
negative_evidence: Equal artifact digest must never merge entity identity.
All-pairs peer topology was rejected as unnecessary and poorly scaling.
counterhypotheses: For very small peer sets an all-pairs cache may be cheaper operationally despite inferior asymptotic behavior.
required_validation: Target-VPS rebuild/recovery of derived lineage topology from UnifiedDB authoritative state.
ClayGraph lesion proving topology remains diagnostic/reconstructible rather than truth storage.
ancestry_policy: Copy benchmark and temporal-identity implementation are one research lineage, not independent replication.
